svg.title: iOS · Gallery · Library sheet · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryView.swift (compact branch — the .sheet(isPresented: $showSidebarSheet) block, which wraps App/GallerySidebar.swift in a NavigationStack titled "Library" with a "Done" confirmationAction) as shipped on 2026-09-11, code first, mirrored from the running app. THE SHEET the ▤ Library button in gallery.portrait.svg's compact header raises on an iPhone; on iPad and Mac the same GallerySidebar is the fixed 200pt pane in macOS/gallery.svg instead. It rises over the dimmed Gallery — the parent's top edge (#D5D5D9, x 17, 359 wide, rx 10) peeks 10pt above it, right under the status bar — with a 10pt corner radius, LL.screenBackground, "Done" 17pt semibold in LL.accent trailing 16 (baseline 103), and the large title "Library" 34pt bold 16 in (baseline 160). BELOW IT, GallerySidebar's own ScrollView: VStack(spacing 20) of four sections, a hairline Divider between each pair (.padding(.horizontal, 12) → x 12–381), .padding(.top, 14). Every section header is LLSectionHeader — 13pt semibold, kerning 0.5, secondary, uppercased — 18pt in (the sidebar's 14 + the header's own 4). LIBRARY: the four CaptureFilter.withoutScans rows drawn by LibraryFilterRow — HStack(spacing 10) of a 14pt-medium SF Symbol in a 20pt-wide frame (centred at x 28) and the 14pt label (x 48), .padding(.horizontal, 14) .padding(.vertical, 7) inside a further .padding(.horizontal, 4), VStack spacing 2 — square.grid.2x2 "All", photo "Photos", square.stack "Interval", film "Video". All is the selected filter here, so its row draws the selected state: LL.accent @ 10% RoundedRectangle(8) spanning x 4–389 by 31pt (y 208.5–239.5), accent glyph, accent label. The others: secondary glyph, primary label, no capsule. Rows nominally pitch 33 (31 + 2); measured 33 / 34.7 / 33.6 — see the note at the end. TAGS: present only when the visible library carries any scene tag (`if !presentTags.isEmpty`) — three here, Urban · People · Vehicles, from allCaptures.presentSceneTags through SceneMetadata.label. Each row is a 7pt Circle (primary @ 25% at rest, LL.accent when on) at x 14, spacing 10, then the 14pt label at x 31, .padding(.horizontal, 14) .padding(.vertical, 6), VStack spacing 2 → pitch 31 (baselines 423 · 454 · 485). Tags are cumulative (a project must carry every lit tag); while any is lit a 12pt medium LL.accent "Clear tags" link sits 14pt in, 2pt under the last row (not drawn — none lit). COLLECTIONS: one LibraryFilterRow, rectangle.stack "All Collections", never selected — it is not a filter but a door: it sets model.requestedTab = .collections. It does NOT dismiss this sheet (nothing writes showSidebarSheet = false on that path), so on an iPhone the tab switches underneath and the person finds Collections when they tap Done — noted as shipped, not changed here. SHAPES (new, 2026-09-11 — GallerySidebar.shapesSection over ShapeFilter.allCases and AppModel.shapeSummaries, refreshed onAppear by model.refreshShapeSummaries()): four LibraryFilterRows in the register's vocabulary — oval "Ellipse", rectangle "Rectangle", square "Square", circle.slash "No Shapes" — drawn at rest here, none lit (glyph centres y 659.5 · 692.5 · 725.5 · 759.5, label baselines 664 · 697 · 730 · 764). A project shows under Ellipse / Rectangle / Square when its shapes.json register (written by Create ▸ Shape-mation ▸ Find shapes, or by a shape drawn in the photo editor's Masks tab) holds one of that family, and under No Shapes when the register is empty or was never written — so the pictures the detector missed can be browsed to and given a shape by hand. All four rows are always offered: an empty row is the prompt to run Find shapes, not a dead control. A LIT ROW draws exactly like All above — LL.accent @ 10% capsule x 4–389 × 31 rx 8, accent glyph, accent label. Rows narrow like the tag rows: a project must hold EVERY lit shape (Set<ShapeFilter>.toggle). No Shapes is exclusive — lighting it clears the three families and lighting a family clears it — and means an empty register or none at all. While any shape row is lit a 12pt medium LL.accent "Clear shapes" link sits 14pt in, 4pt under the last row, exactly as "Clear tags" does under the tags (neither link is drawn — the rest state has nothing to clear). And the ▤ Library button in the Gallery header behind this sheet lights LL.accent whenever a shape row is lit, the same as when the kind filter or a tag narrows the library (GalleryView.libraryButton: isLit = filter != .all || !query.tags.isEmpty || !shapeSelection.isEmpty). Bottom: the ScrollView's .padding(.bottom, 20); the sheet has no tab bar. STATES NOT DRAWN: a lit tag or shape row and its Clear link; a library with no tags (the TAGS section and its divider vanish and COLLECTIONS moves up); the sheet's own scrolled state (this content fits at rest). HOOKS: LL_TAB=gallery brings the tab front; LL_SHAPES=ellipse,rectangle,square,empty (any subset) seeds the lit shape rows for screenshots; there is no hook that opens this sheet — it is one tap on ▤. MEASURED from Steven's iPhone 16 Pro screenshot (1206×2622 px = 402×874 pt @3×, not the 393×852 canvas): leading and trailing insets are kept as measured, so row capsules and dividers are 9pt shorter here; the sheet's top edge sat at 72 there (status bar 62 + 10) and is drawn at 69 on this canvas (status bar 59 + 10) — the 56 in manage-presets.portrait.svg, this file's template, was drawn design-first and never measured against a device. One shipped rhythm quirk, drawn as measured: LibraryFilterRow fixes the symbol's WIDTH at 20 but not its height, so rows whose symbol is taller than the 17pt text line (square.stack, film) run 1–2pt taller than the 31pt text rows — the LIBRARY rows pitch 33 / 34.7 / 33.6 rather than an even 33. **2026-09-15 — a VIEW section on top:** the Timeline switch (GallerySidebar.viewSection, drawn only when the sidebar is this sheet — GalleryView passes `$timelineMode`; the wide layouts pass nothing and keep the Timeline button in their header row). It is here because the portrait header's Timeline glyph gave its seat to the sync pill (gallery.portrait.svg) and the mode is remembered across launches — without a switch a phone would be trapped in whichever mode it last set elsewhere. Toggle tinted LL.accent, calendar glyph secondary at rest and accent while on, "Timeline" 14pt, a 12pt caption "Tiles grouped by shoot day, with a month rail", a divider, then LIBRARY as before — everything below moved down 105.5, so SHAPES now runs under the fold and the sheet scrolls (the "fits at rest" note above no longer holds). Verified on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator (iOS 18.6) 2026-09-15: the switch reads the remembered mode (drawn on when `-gallery.timelineMode YES` is passed) and the grid follows it; the simulator tool cannot flip a UISwitch by a synthesized tap, so the flip itself was not driven — it is the same `$timelineMode` binding the wide header's Toggle writes.

g.text: Tiles grouped by shoot day, with a month rail
